description: Measure your annual cash-on-cash return from cash invested and pre-tax cash flow on a rental property.

faqs.a: Cash-on-cash return = annual pre-tax cash flow ÷ total cash invested. It measures the return on the cash you actually put in, ignoring appreciation.
Cash invested usually means down payment plus closing costs and any initial repairs — all out-of-pocket cash before financing.
Cap rate measures the property's return on its full value (unleveraged); cash-on-cash measures your return on the cash you invested (leveraged).

howto: Enter your down payment and closing costs.
Enter the annual pre-tax cash flow (rent minus all expenses and mortgage).
title: Cash-on-Cash Return Calculator
